E0108

`HookDecision.Fail` needs String (text), not Int (a whole number)

What

`HookDecision.Fail` needs String (text), not Int (a whole number)

Why

The decision payload must match the hook's declared payload or error type

Fix

Put the value in text with interpolation: "{x}"

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0108: tests/ui/E0108_int_narrowing_lambda_return.stderr.

Error [E0108]: This needs U8, but the value is Int
  --> tests/ui/E0108_int_narrowing_lambda_return.jet:4:24
    |
  4 |     print(apply((n) -> n * 2, 5))
    |                        ^^^^^
 Why: The value here does not have the type required by this declaration
 Fix: Convert it with `U8.from_int(value) ?? fallback`; the conversion is `None` when the value doesn't fit in U8
